items.name: Sinotau Pharmaceutical (9941.HK)

note.de: Spanne 52–68 HKD, Zeichnung beendet; Privatanleger-Tranche laut Medien vielfach überzeichnet (über Margin-Kredite), Endpreis bis 23.11. morgens noch nicht veröffentlicht, Handelsstart 24.11.
note.bg: Диапазон 52–68 HKD, записването е приключило; траншът за частни инвеститори според медиите е многократно презаписан (чрез маржин кредити), крайната цена до сутринта на 23.11. не е публикувана, търговия от 24.11.
note.en: Range HKD 52–68, books closed; retail tranche many times oversubscribed via margin loans according to media, final price not yet published as of the morning of 23 Nov, trading from 24 Nov.
note.es: Rango 52–68 HKD, suscripción cerrada; tramo minorista sobresuscrito muchas veces con préstamos de margen según la prensa, precio final aún no publicado la mañana del 23/11, cotiza desde el 24/11.
note.tr: Aralık 52–68 HKD, talep toplama bitti; basına göre bireysel dilim marj kredileriyle kat kat aşıldı, nihai fiyat 23.11 sabahı itibarıyla henüz açıklanmadı, işlem 24.11'de başlıyor.

note.en: Offer price EUR 10.00 (bottom of the 10–11.50 range), 30m shares, 25m of them new – about EUR 300m; exact demand and allocation on 25 Nov, first trading on 26 Nov.
note.es: Precio de 10,00 euros (parte baja del rango 10–11,50), 30 millones de acciones, 25 millones nuevas: unos 300 millones; demanda exacta y asignación el 25/11, cotiza el 26/11.
note.tr: Fiyat 10,00 euro (10–11,50 aralığının alt ucu), 30 milyon hisse, 25 milyonu yeni – yaklaşık 300 milyon euro; kesin talep ve dağıtım 25.11'de, ilk işlem 26.11'de.

items.name: Mahanadi Coalfields (MCL)

note.de: Coal India verkauft 10 % der Tochter zu 129–136 Rupien; am letzten Zeichnungstag 23.11. um 10:57 Uhr (IST) erst zu 54 % gezeichnet (Großanleger 1,37-fach), Zuteilung 25.11., Notierung 27.11.
note.bg: Coal India продава 10% от дъщерното дружество по 129–136 рупии; в последния ден, 23.11., в 10:57 ч. (IST) записването е едва 54% (институционалните 1,37 пъти), разпределение 25.11., листване 27.11.
note.en: Coal India sells 10% of the unit at INR 129–136; on the last day, 23 Nov, at 10:57 IST only 54% subscribed (institutions 1.37 times), allotment 25 Nov, listing 27 Nov.
note.es: Coal India vende el 10 % de la filial a 129–136 rupias; el último día, 23/11, a las 10:57 IST solo cubierta al 54 % (institucionales 1,37 veces), asignación el 25/11, cotiza el 27/11.
note.tr: Coal India iştirakinin %10'unu 129–136 rupiden satıyor; son gün 23.11'de saat 10:57 (IST) itibarıyla yalnızca %54 talep (kurumsallar 1,37 kat), dağıtım 25.11, işlem 27.11.

note.en: Secondary sale only of 4.17m existing shares (plus 0.63m over-allotment); offer price set on 18 Nov at JPY 1,240, the top of the range, subscription 19–25 Nov.

items.name: Anthropic (ANT)

note.de: Ausgabepreis 83 USD (Spanne war 70–78 USD); am ersten Handelstag 19.11. Eröffnung bei 111,50 USD, Schlusskurs 97,17 USD – 17,1 % über dem Ausgabepreis; Abschluss des Angebots am 20.11.
note.bg: Цена при предлагането 83 USD (диапазонът беше 70–78 USD); в първия ден на търговия, 19.11., отваряне при 111,50 USD, затваряне при 97,17 USD – със 17,1% над цената на предлагането; приключване на 20.11.
note.en: Offer price USD 83 (range was USD 70–78); on the first trading day, 19 Nov, it opened at USD 111.50 and closed at USD 97.17 – 17.1% above the offer price; offering closes on 20 Nov.
note.es: Precio de salida 83 USD (el rango era 70–78 USD); en su primer día, el 19/11, abrió a 111,50 USD y cerró a 97,17 USD, un 17,1 % por encima del precio de salida; cierre de la oferta el 20/11.
note.tr: Halka arz fiyatı 83 USD (aralık 70–78 USD idi); 19.11'deki ilk işlem gününde 111,50 USD'den açıldı, 97,17 USD'den kapandı – halka arz fiyatının %17,1 üzerinde; arzın kapanışı 20.11.
